purpose: Test whether CPU TGS incoming/projected joint force depends incorrectly on allocation of the same equilibrium generalized torque to feedforward versus implicit drive
controller: Same original robot gains/damping/limits/mount/solver. Diagnostic targets q0+(1-fraction)*native_gravity/K, explicit effort fraction*native_gravity; desired velocity0. Initial-state reset only between cases. Arms only; hands unchanged.
prediction: At comparable actual states, net transmitted load should be independent of torque-source split. Large split-dependent readout changes with unchanged equilibrium would contradict using the readout as actual generalized motor torque.
validity: Keep all inherited clear-space checks. Require arm pose drift<0.0001rad and maximum arm speed<0.001rad/s for static comparison; archive actual body velocities/mass for independent dynamic bound.
comparison: Report exact split differences and independent subtree gravity reference; no replacement of old force/work thresholds. No full-work qualification from this diagnostic.
stop: One invocation; no parameter sweep or contact. If controls fail or hypothesis unsupported, stop with saved result. No automatic production change.
